notes:
v0.3.41 - the agent can work the app itself, and remembers out loud

NEW: ask it to run the setup questions again and it puts them on screen. It
used to send you looking for a Settings page that does not exist.

NEW: it can read and change what it knows about your business. Ask what it has
on file, search it, correct a line, or tell it to forget one - and it shows you
the exact wording before deleting anything. Everything it knows was always in
/memory for you to edit; now the agent can see it too, instead of answering
from whichever few notes happened to be loaded that minute.

NEW: standing instructions stick. "Write my posts in Latvian from now on" now
changes the setting that every post is written from, rather than being agreed
to and forgotten by the next message. Same for tone, audience, and the language
DMs and emails are answered in.

NEW: it can cancel a scheduled post and clear an item off your escalations
queue. It could always show you both lists and could not act on either. It
quotes the row back and asks first - and resolving an escalation says plainly
that it has NOT replied to that person, only taken it off your list.

NEW: it can tell you which version you are on, whether an update is waiting and
what it changes, which AI model is actually answering you, and which local
models your PC has. And it can disconnect an account.

FIXED: "what accounts do you have?" now includes your mailbox. It only ever
looked at the social logins, so it could name every handle and miss the inbox
it had been reading all morning.

FIXED: the Settings screen was showing garbled characters where dashes, ticks
and arrows should be - in the API-key section, the update panel and the list of
what is installed on your PC. It has looked like that since 0.3.33.

CHANGED: a handful of the agent's tools were merged so that each one covers a
whole subject rather than a single question. Nothing you can ask for got
smaller; several things that had no answer now have one.

NOT IN THIS BUILD: sending a direct message to somebody who has not written to
you first. The code ships turned off while the part that finds a person in
Instagram's message box is tested properly. Asked to do it, the agent now says
it cannot, instead of running the unread sweep and reporting success having
messaged nobody.
